values./system/biography: A mutated shark and apex predator of the irradiated seas.
values./items/@721832abb6fe6742/system/descript: This creature can swim and remain submerged indefinitely and suffers no underwater attack or movement penalties.
values./items/@557dceaecb90bad1/system/descript: +1 HP per level is included; Defense is reduced by 1 and critical hits require 7 damage.
values./items/@b611549f701fe191/system/descript: Generate 1 AP when it enters a scene.
values./items/@83a4957ea4663888/system/descript: It must use its first action to move or begin drowning.
values./items/@10c7010ccd88553f/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
